FEATUREFINDER/ElutionPeakDetection.h: a hand-written port, not the standard library: the class's own public members are covered, the constructor as new/Default, both detectPeaks overloads as detect_peaks/detect_peaks_many (plus *_into), filterByPeakWidth, computeMassTraceNoise, computeMassTraceSNR, computeApexSNR, findLocalExtrema (returning ElutionExtrema), smoothData, and all six defaults (chrom_fwhm, chrom_peak_snr, width_filtering, min_fwhm, max_fwhm, masstrace_snr_filtering) as ElutionPeakDetectionOptions fields; the ProgressLogger base is the logger field. Gap: the inherited DefaultParamHandler surface is unported (no defaults()/from_param/to_param), so a Param tree can neither configure it nor be read back.
FEATUREFINDER/FeatureFindingMetabo.h: a hand-written port, not the standard library: FeatureHypothesis's public members are covered (the constructors, getSize as len, getLabel/getLabels, get/setScore, get/setCharge, getAllIntensities, getAllCentroidMZ/RT/IM, getIsotopeDistances, getCentroidMZ/RT, getFWHM, addMassTrace, getMonoisotopicFeatureIntensity, getSummedFeatureIntensity, getMaxIntensity, getNumFeatPoints, getConvexHulls, getChromatograms), CmpMassTraceByMZ and CmpHypothesesByScore as mass_trace_mz_less/hypothesis_score_greater, Range as MetaboIsotopeMassWindow, and FeatureFindingMetabo's constructor, run and all 19 defaults as FeatureFindingMetaboOptions fields; the ProgressLogger base is the logger field. Gap: the inherited DefaultParamHandler surface is unported (no defaults()/from_param/to_param), so a Param tree can neither configure it nor be read back.
FEATUREFINDER/MassTraceDetection.h: a hand-written port, not the standard library: the class's own public members are covered, TraceTerminationCriterion, the constructor as new/Default, both run overloads as run/run_into and run_area, hasFwhmMz, hasFwhmIm, hasCentroidIm, and all 11 defaults as MassTraceDetectionOptions fields; the ProgressLogger base is the logger field. Gap: the inherited DefaultParamHandler surface is unported (no defaults()/from_param/to_param), so a Param tree can neither configure it nor be read back.
INTERFACES/IMSDataConsumer.h: a hand-written trait, not a standard-library type: the four pure virtuals (consumeSpectrum, consumeChromatogram, setExpectedSize, setExperimentalSettings) are the MSDataConsumer trait's consume_spectrum, consume_chromatogram, set_expected_size and set_experimental_settings; the SpectrumType/ChromatogramType typedefs are the concrete MSSpectrum/MSChromatogram argument types.
